:::{#thm-cv-estimate-by-fold}
#### The cross-validation estimate, fold by fold

The [cross-validation estimate](#def-cv-estimate) sums,
fold by fold,
the squared errors of each fold's observations
under the [fitted model](#def-fitted-model) fitted without that [fold](#def-folds),
and divides the total by $\nobs$:

$$
\cvest{\nfolds} = \frac{1}{\nobs} \sumto{\ifold}{\nfolds} \sum_{\iobs \in \fold{\ifold}} \sqf{\fittedwo{\ifold}{\predvar_{\iobs}} - \outvar_{\iobs}}.
$$ {#eq-cv-estimate-by-fold}

:::

::: proof
This is @sol-cv-estimate-by-fold.
:::
